title: yellowish creamy tunisian fromage frais tagine
description: nutty, creamy, and adventurous tunisian dish made with fromage frais and cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot. a delicious and exotic meal for any occasion.
instructions: in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the almond butter and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
add the chopped dates, cinnamon, and salt. cook for 2-3 minutes, until the dates start to soften.
add the fromage frais and stir until well combined.
add the water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the tagine has thickened slightly.
serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
